name: green-custom-or-stdv-sessions
note: Three sessions, one spawn each, asserted as the WHOLE ascending item list. This is the assertion a single-session fixture cannot make: a spawn condition that fires once instead of three times fails here on length, and max_kept / label_latest_only stop being trivially true. TWO THINGS ARE LOAD-BEARING AND MUST NOT BE 'SIMPLIFIED'. (1) The ORB timeframe (15m) is deliberately COARSER than the bar interval (5m), so the isORBar plateau is 2 bars and the edge-trigger in the .os file is actually exercised - a 1:1 ratio passes with or without it. (2) Per-day OR highs and lows differ (110/90, 220/180, 330/270) so a port that reuses the first session's captured values fails on price rather than passing by coincidence. Past sessions now CLOSE at their own session end (terminate.new_session) while the live session rides the edge, so the x2bar/open columns differ per item - that is the fix for the overlapping-history problem the first chart review found. The label column IS the label_latest_only assertion: only the newest item carries a label. All prices derived from the per-day high/low by the documented formulas, not copied from engine output.
